Draft/Notes

Slide 1 — Welcome & Agenda
- Brief welcome, company value proposition
- Introductions: customer team and onboarding team roles
- Meeting objectives, agenda, and timeline

Slide 2 — Customer Success Plan Overview
- Key milestones and success metrics (KPIs)
- Implementation phases and responsibility matrix
- Communication cadence and escalation path

Slide 3 — Product Setup & Access
- Account provisioning, user roles, and permissions
- Initial configuration checklist and estimated timeline
- Data migration/import requirements and ownership

Slide 4 — Training & Enablement
- Training schedule: workshops, webinars, and owners
- Self-service resources: knowledge base and guides
- Hands-on sandbox exercises and success criteria

Slide 5 — Support & Ongoing Operations
- Support channels, response SLAs, and escalation contacts
- Regular health checks, performance reviews, and reporting
- Maintenance, updates, and security/compliance practices

Slide 6 — Next Steps & Commitments
- Immediate action items, owners, and due dates
- Success criteria, review checkpoints, and launch readiness
- Q&A and scheduling the kickoff follow-up meeting
